goal: docs/runbooks/analytics-measurement-plan.md maps what the site tracks today with file:line, names the gaps, ranks five opportunities by impact and effort, proposes a small KPI set with event names, and lays out 30- and 60-day outcomes with proposed GitHub issues, each with a measurable success metric and with every dashboard-dependent fact marked not checked.
out_of_scope: Any instrumentation or code change: app/, components/, layouts/, lib/, css/, data/, public/, scripts/, tests/, root config files, package.json, package-lock.json
Changing the GA4 property, dashboards, Speed Insights settings or the reporting tooling
Reading live analytics accounts, dashboards, provider consoles or the external Codex skill
acceptance: test -f docs/runbooks/analytics-measurement-plan.md && bash scripts/pipeline-check.sh lint, plus the document structure and reference checks of task write-measurement-plan and the scope guard of task no-code-change

tasks.title: Write the analytics measurement plan runbook
tasks.description: Create docs/runbooks/analytics-measurement-plan.md to the outline in design.md D1 and the conventions in D3, using the evidence in investigation.md. Re-read and cite each path:line at the current HEAD. Verified by the design.md D2 document check: the headings are present, five ranked rows, the Success metric and GitHub issues columns, three or more Not checked bullets, the required citations, every cited path:line resolving, no G- measurement id, and lint passing.
tasks.acceptance: f=docs/runbooks/analytics-measurement-plan.md; test -f "$f" && for h in '## Sources and method' '## What is tracked today' '## Gaps' '## Top five opportunities' '## Proposed KPIs' '## 30-day plan' '## 60-day plan' '## Not checked'; do grep -qxF "$h" "$f" || exit 1; done && grep -qE '^\| 5 \|' "$f" && [ "$(grep -c 'Success metric' "$f")" -ge 4 ] && [ "$(grep -c 'GitHub issues' "$f")" -ge 2 ] && awk '/^## Not checked$/{s=1;next} /^## /{s=0} s && /^- /{n++} END{exit !(n>=3)}' "$f" && grep -q 'components/analytics.tsx:[0-9]' "$f" && grep -q 'app/layout.tsx:[0-9]' "$f" && grep -qE 'scripts/ga-[a-z-]+\.sh:[0-9]' "$f" && ! grep -qE 'G-[A-Z0-9]{8,}' "$f" && grep -oE '((app|components|layouts|lib|scripts|data)/[^ :`)|]+|next\.config\.js|package\.json):[0-9]+' "$f" | sort -u | while IFS=: read -r p l; do [ -f "$p" ] && [ "$(wc -l < "$p")" -ge "$l" ] || exit 1; done && bash scripts/pipeline-check.sh lint

tasks.title: Guard that no source, config or package path changed
tasks.description: Confirm that no source, config or package path differs from the merge base with origin/main and that none is untracked, so the change stays documentation-only. Verified by git diff --quiet against the merge base, an empty untracked list over the same paths, and lint passing.
tasks.acceptance: git diff --quiet "$(git merge-base HEAD refs/remotes/origin/main)" -- app components layouts lib css data public scripts tests .npmrc contentlayer.config.ts eslint.config.js jsconfig.json next.config.js package.json package-lock.json playwright.config.ts postcss.config.js prettier.config.js tailwind.config.js tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts && [ -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- app components layouts lib css data public scripts tests .npmrc contentlayer.config.ts eslint.config.js jsconfig.json next.config.js package.json package-lock.json playwright.config.ts postcss.config.js prettier.config.js tailwind.config.js tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts)" ] && bash scripts/pipeline-check.sh lint
